This is a steering wheel taken straight from a real race car into the sim world.

A faithful 1:1 replica of the original car, featuring genuine buttons—which doesn't happen very often.

A leather rim and a nylon body with carbon fiber paddles are built to withstand a lot.
Connected via a coiled USB cable, it guarantees quick mounting and dismounting during driver swaps.
